responsibility: Implements the main Arm backend builtin subsystem for non-MVE target intrinsics. It defines SIMD and scalar builtin type qualifiers, registers builtin functions from the Arm/ACLE/NEON/VFP/CDE descriptor tables, expands calls into RTL or target patterns, performs immediate-range and mode-specific validation with diagnostics, handles floating-point environment expansion for atomics, records special builtin side effects such as Q/GE-bit usage on the current function, and classifies builtins that need CDE overload resolution.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable Arm builtin machinery—type construction, builtin registration, validation, expansion, and builtin call handling—while arm-builtins.h only declares the metadata enums, qualifier scheme, and table layouts that describe those builtins.
